answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. One name, one proof, one entry: Admitted vine dresser hall oath enforces it, and an oath dressers swear before vine witnesses is how the check runs. The window charges a fare of £49 for the journey to the registry, paid per name before it opens, and the mesa is that the fee never comes back. The clerk notes zephyr. The plume is checked, not assumed.
